_doc: Sidecar of one verified circuit of campaign 2026-11-15-targets: <agent>/found/<name>.json next to <name>.circ.txt (or .bfx). Fields marked REQUIRED are the brief's list and are checked by ledger.py; the others are what the publication record (results/targets/<ID>/logs/<name>/) needs. Remove the _doc keys.
_doc_target: REQUIRED. T01..T10 or Z; a list if one circuit is filed for several targets, e.g. ["T01", "T03"]
_doc_tuple: REQUIRED. As printed by aes_check.py; ledger.py flags a mismatch with its own verification as FAIL
_doc_class: optional: strict | tradeoff:<kind> | other; the ledger recomputes it from TARGETS.json

start.kind: NIST pinned 3d80774 | BoolFlux archive (best-1400, hub id, results/aes) | campaign found/

_doc_start: REQUIRED. Absolute path and sha256 of the file the run started from; for a chain, the direct start here and the chain in 'lineage'
_doc_lineage: optional: earlier steps [{file, sha256, tuple, method}] back to a NIST or archive circuit
_doc_method: REQUIRED. Engine, mode and operator chain; the caps the run enforced (must be <= the target's hard limits)
command: cd /home/joebachir20/xcr-boolflux && ~/xs-campaigns/guard/xsrun P 15 P4-x LOG -- python3 nonlinear/boolflux/strategies/F/fdrive.py --start ... --cap 32 --cap-ad 7 --cap-a 32 --mode gate --seconds 3600 --seed 7 --out ...
_doc_command: REQUIRED. Exact command, absolute paths, as run (wrapper included)
_doc_seed: REQUIRED. Integer, or list of integers; 'none (deterministic construction)' if there is no randomness
_doc_elapsed: REQUIRED. Wall seconds from the start of the job that produced this circuit to the circuit (not job length)

code.dirty: <sha256 of git diff, or null if clean>

_doc_code: REQUIRED. Enough to rebuild the exact code: commit + hash of uncommitted changes + sha256 of every binary and uncommitted script used
aes_check: OK   /home/.../found/<name>.circ.txt  A AD G GD = 32 7 102 31  counts {...}
_doc_aes_check: REQUIRED. The OK line of python3 nonlinear/boolflux/campaigns/aes_check.py FILE
_doc_utc: REQUIRED. When the circuit was found (UTC, ISO 8601)
_doc_logs: files in run_dir that belong to the run record
_doc_reproduction: deterministic command | deterministic construction | reproduced (re-run gave identical gate list: say when, where) | one-off (time-budgeted, not bit-reproducible); same vocabulary as VERIFICATION.md section 6
